title_en: The 49ers’ 2025 season in numbers: every advanced stat at a glance

body_en:
*Season Stats 2025, part 4 of 4. The series by Chris Pracher: Part 1: Understanding advanced stats · Part 2: Season Stats 2025, offense deep dive · Part 3: Season Stats 2025, defense deep dive · **Part 4: The 49ers' season in numbers**.*

## The 49ers' 2025 season in numbers: every advanced stat at a glance

If you have read our season reviews of the offense and defense, this is where you will find all the numbers behind them, neatly sorted by unit. This compilation lists every advanced stat we gathered for the 2025 season, each with the 49ers' value and, in parentheses, their rank within the league. It is meant as a reference, not as running text, and is best read alongside our glossary of metrics (part 1 of the series).

How to read the tables: each cell shows the 49ers' value and, in parentheses, their league rank. On defense, a low rank is not automatically good, so it is worth checking the glossary.

## 1. Team metrics (offense and defense)

The foundation: the efficiency of each unit as a whole. For EPA and success rate, a high value is good for the offense and a low value is good for the defense; DVOA follows the same logic via its sign.
